blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Capital1 landed another prized recruit in former Alas Pilipinas and Galeries Tower setter, Julia Coronel, ahead of the new PVL season. The Solar Spikers on Thursday announced the signing of Coronel, who recently parted ways with Galeries after two years. The setter out of La Salle was drafted by Galeries at No.3 in the inaugural draft in 2024 and made impressive Play-In runs with the franchise in the past two seasons. Capital1 could be adding the missing piece, as the setter joins two former league MVPs, Vanie Gandler and Erika Santos, and last season’s Rookie of the Year […]...
